verified: The NEA reported ~1.33 TW cumulative solar capacity at end-October 2026, +16.3% year on year, with 12.86 GW added in October and ~123.69 GW in January–October, per pv magazine. Jiangsu's development and reform commission published the 13 TWh, CNY 0.200–0.391/kWh, 10-year-settlement framework. Trina Solar's board-level plan to inject CNY 1.35 billion into Trina Storage would lift its stake from 60.14% to 68.43%.
unconfirmed: The Trina capital injection is subject to shareholder approval and has not closed. Longi's and Trina's 2027 related-party transaction figures (CNY 1.186 billion and CNY 152 million) are estimates, not confirmed orders. The Yongjie Aluminum project is not yet running; the Dec. 28 start date and the projected CNY 9 million carbon-tariff and CNY 3 million electricity savings are the NEA's and project partners' expectations. China Huaneng's 400 MW offshore solar project has only begun construction.

verified: 国家能源局数据显示，截至2026年10月底，中国光伏累计装机约1.33太瓦，同比增长16.3%，10月新增12.86吉瓦；江苏省发改委已公布2027年机制电价竞价框架，初始电量为13太瓦时，报价区间为0.200—0.391元/千瓦时，结算期10年。
unconfirmed: 竞价最终出清价格、可结算电量分配和项目中标结果，以及拍卖的具体时间表；该框架只规定了规则，尚未给出这些结果。

titles.en: China's Solar Capacity Reaches 1.33 TW as Jiangsu Sets 2027 Auction Terms
titles.zh: 中国光伏累计装机达1.33太瓦，江苏公布2027年竞价框架
